plaza.t15:
The only thing we go on is the name the visitor’s own software gives us.
                    Anything that hides is simply not recognised — it goes to “unknown” and is not counted as a person.
                    We do not use techniques that follow visitors around to catch more.

plaza.t26: What you type into a tool never goes to the server.
plaza.t27: Every tool runs inside your browser — files, text and photos never leave this computer.
plaza.t28: We do not store IP addresses.
plaza.t29: To tell whether it is the same person we use a key mixed so it cannot be turned back, and we keep only today’s and drop it when the day changes.
plaza.t30: There are no tracking ads or analytics tools.
plaza.t31: The numbers above are only what our own server counted.
plaza.t32: Several moves by the same person within 30 minutes count as one — we would rather not inflate the number.
